opportunity.title: Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) Bridge Notice of Intent to Sole Source
opportunity.description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency intends to issue a sole-source bridge IDIQ contract to Leidos for Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2), supporting the FS2 program through April 2028 until a competitive follow-on IDIQ can be awarded. Scope: continued integration, software maintenance, operations support and limited development for current mission capabilities of the Source Directorate, across Mapping, Charting and Geodesy mission areas: aeronautical, maritime, topographic, geopolitical geography, elevation, geodesy and controlled imagery.

profile.pastPerformance: Women-owned, economically disadvantaged. One Marine Corps training-data contract (about $1.5M) and two civilian-agency analytics task orders under $800K.
profile.capacityNotes: Eleven staff. No facility clearance. Past performance is strongest in training and education data systems.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

checks.reason: Full and open competition; no set-aside required.
NAICS 541511 is in the company's codes.
Place of performance VA is within the company's coverage.

rationale.point: The notice explicitly states intent to sole-source the FS2 bridge contract to Leidos, eliminating competitive opportunity for other firms.
The procurement has no small-business set-aside (set-aside NONE), so Magnolia's WOSB/EDWOSB status provides no eligibility advantage.

The requirement involves large-scale foundation sustainment services for the NGA's FS2 program through 2028, which aligns with the very high median award values ($150M) and exceeds Magnolia's 11-person capacity and past performance ceiling (~$1.5M).

risks: Sole-source award to Leidos is already planned; no competitive pathway exists.
Contract magnitude far exceeds company's demonstrated capacity and past performance.
No facility clearance limits ability to perform on-site work at NGA locations.
Past performance is in training/education data systems, not geospatial-intelligence sustainment.
nextSteps: Track future competitive solicitations under NAICS 541511 with small-business set-asides.
Explore subcontracting or teaming opportunities with Leidos or other primes on FS2-related work.
Pursue smaller task-order vehicles (e.g., GSA schedules, agency-specific IDIQs) that match Magnolia's analytics and training-data strengths.
